shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Abu stands beside the steaming hot spring with the small white towel on his head. Steam drifts past him from the right. He tilts his round head to one side so the towel slips a little, lifts one white hand to scratch the side of his head, and asks his puzzled question while his blue heart pulses brighter on each word. After the line his mouth closes, he straightens the towel with both hands and looks toward the frozen lake on the left.
